#include <array>
#include <iostream>
#include <stack>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

struct Pos {
	int r, c;
};

struct Node {
	Pos pos;
	int nextDir; // 0..3: east, south, west, north
};

int main() {
	array<string, 10> maze;
	Pos start{-1, -1}, finish{-1, -1};
	
	for (int r = 0; r < 10; ++r) {
		if (!getline(cin, maze[r])) return 0;
		if (!maze[r].empty() && maze[r].back() == '\r') maze[r].pop_back();
		if (maze[r].size() < 10) maze[r].append(10 - maze[r].size(), ' ');
		for (int c = 0; c < 10; ++c) {
			if (maze[r][c] == 'S') start = {r, c};
			if (maze[r][c] == 'E') finish = {r, c};
		}
	}
	
	const int dr[4] = {0, 1, 0, -1};
	const int dc[4] = {1, 0, -1, 0};
	bool visited[10][10] = {};
	stack<Node> path;
	path.push({start, 0});
	visited[start.r][start.c] = true;
	
	bool found = false;
	while (!path.empty()) {
		Node &cur = path.top();
		if (cur.pos.r == finish.r && cur.pos.c == finish.c) {
			found = true;
			break;
		}
		
		bool moved = false;
		while (cur.nextDir < 4) {
			int dir = cur.nextDir++;
			int nr = cur.pos.r + dr[dir];
			int nc = cur.pos.c + dc[dir];
			if (nr < 0 || nr >= 10 || nc < 0 || nc >= 10 ||
				visited[nr][nc] || maze[nr][nc] == '#') {
				continue;
			}
			visited[nr][nc] = true;
			path.push({{nr, nc}, 0});
			moved = true;
			break;
		}
		
		if (!moved) {
			// A dead branch is marked immediately; S is handled the same way
			// when no route to E exists.
			maze[cur.pos.r][cur.pos.c] = '!';
			path.pop();
		}
	}
	
	if (found) {
		while (!path.empty()) {
			maze[path.top().pos.r][path.top().pos.c] = '*';
			path.pop();
		}
	}
	
	for (const string &row : maze) cout << row.substr(0, 10) << '\n';
	return 0;
}
